items.quote: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
items.claim: The text says Moses and at least one companion (unnamed in this verse) took ashes from a furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses threw the ashes up toward the sky, and the text says this caused boils with blisters on both people and animals.
items.action: sprinkled ashes of the furnace up toward heaven before Pharaoh
items.object: man and beast (afflicted with boils breaking forth with blains)
items.mechanism: The ashes thrown into the air are said to have become boils with blisters on people and animals. The verse gives no natural cause.
items.place: Before Pharaoh (the verse does not name the place; reading it as Egypt is only an unverified model-prior)
